name: triage-webapp

dependencies.name: ticket-api
dependencies.description: Submits tickets, lists the triage queue, and edits/approves drafted replies.

description: The single-page app customers use to submit a support ticket (public, no sign-in) and support agents use to sign in, review their triage queue sorted by urgency, and edit and approve AI-drafted replies. Talks only to ticket-api; holds no data of its own.
